name: The Asking
_comment: Beat 3 of docs/FIRST-THIRTY.md, and the first anomaly a save ever opens. It is a survey rather than a task chain because the player has not been told what an anomaly is yet, and being asked something is a better first lesson than being asked for ten push-ups. Every answer grants a tag, which is a run condition Rules.passes can read, and is filed under `remember` in Meta.self_description, which is what anomaly selection will weight against later. The last node is an action selected by the answers, and it is always a do-this: a player who says they are overnourished is given someone to message, never told to eat less. The three actions are tried in `next` order and the first whose `when` passes takes it, so act_message must stay last and stay unconditional -- it is the default, and without it a run that matches nothing walks out of a memory that asked five questions and wanted nothing.
intro: Nothing in here is furniture. The hole has your outline in it, roughly, the way a chair remembers someone. It is waiting for the rest.
outro: It has what it came for. You are on the record now, in a place that does not keep records.

nodes.label: Your name
nodes.text: It is a fair question, and you are having to think about it.

nodes.label: Your strength
nodes.text: Answer for the body you have today, not the one you had, and not the one you meant to have.

nodes.label: What you eat
nodes.text: It does not want a number. It would not know what to do with one.

nodes.label: Your sleep
nodes.text: Whatever you say here, it is not going to argue with you.

nodes.label: Other people
nodes.text: Last one. Then it will want something done, and it will have picked what.

nodes.label: Eat Something
nodes.text: You said undernourished, so this is what it asks for. One thing that grew, or one thing with protein in it. Not a plan.

nodes.label: Be In Bed On Time
nodes.text: You said running on empty. It is not asking you to sleep, which you cannot promise. It is asking you to be horizontal at the hour you already decided on.

nodes.label: Message Someone
nodes.text: One person. You already know which one, and you knew before you finished reading this. It does not have to be about anything.

nodes.label: The Way Back
nodes.text: The pressure lets go all at once. You are standing in your own house holding something you did not have five minutes ago.
